verdict.rationale: Metorial documents 'branded places' (Portals) where users discover and connect integrations, implying some UI white-labeling for the authorization surface, and it does implement an OAuth flow for user account authorization. However, there is no evidence that a platform-engineer can supply their own OAuth app client ID/secret to replace Metorial's own OAuth app for a given provider (e.g., using a custom Slack/GitHub app instead of Metorial's shared credentials), which is the core of 'own OAuth app credentials.' missing for 10: explicit support for bringing custom OAuth app client ID/secret per provider, documentation of full custom branding/theming controls for the auth consent screen, and any independent confirmation this white-labeling works end-to-end.
